title: PAR-134 MLEADERSTYLE CMC optional name/book retention
scope: Retain optional CMC color-name and color-book-name strings for MLEADERSTYLE leader, text, and block colors
Use bounded R2007+ detached string-stream parsing and writing
Verify C0, C2, and C3 method projection, flags, string order, parse round-trip, and fail-before-output behavior

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: ODA §2.11 defines the optional CMC color-name/book-name flags and TV strings; §20.4.87 identifies the leader, text, and block style colors as CMC. This evidence does not define class-specific DXF truecolor/name/book mappings.

localSource.finding: MLEADERSTYLE previously retained C2 RGB only and discarded CMC names/books in parseDwg; encodeDwg emitted index/RGB with empty optional strings. The model now retains all three independent name/book pairs, the bounded parser captures them, and the writer emits them through the selected string stream.
localSource.compatibility: Six strings were appended after the existing RGB companions, preserving earlier member offsets but changing public class size. Downstream consumers must rebuild; no virtual method changed.

generatedControls.finding: Independent wire walking checks named C0 ByLayer, named C3 ACI, and named C2 truecolor, including body method/index/flags and detached name/book string ordering around description/default text. Production parsing verifies all three colors and strings plus common object handles. A second round-trip preserves named RGB black distinctly from no-RGB state. Missing detached string buffers, out-of-domain scalar values, invalid RGB, and non-normalized scalar/RGB pairs are refused before output. Copy/assignment/reset checks cover all appended strings.
generatedControls.limit: Generated vectors establish local codec consistency only; they are not producer-authored or native-consumer evidence.

productionSummary: Append leader/text/block CMC color-name and color-book-name fields and clear them in reset().
Capture the optional TV fields with readCmColorWithinBounds and the object's bounded detached string cursor.
Emit method-specific C0/C1/C2/C3 CMC with optional names/books through strBuf.
Reject invalid scalar/RGB domains and missing/aliased R2007+ string buffers before output.

unresolved: Class-specific DXF truecolor/name/book mappings for MLEADERSTYLE remain unaudited and are not inferred from DWG CMC evidence.
The broader CMC consumer audit, HATCH C5 producer semantics, and native/external qualification remain separate work.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
